Synopsis:
    A young Australian woman is searching for her missing partner and his family after the August 26 Nepal glacier collapse disaster, which has killed 1,200+ and left 4,200+ missing. She is pressing Apple, Optus, and Life360 to release location data to aid rescue efforts, citing privacy concerns as barriers. The Australian government has pledged A$11M in humanitarian relief and committed to sharing telecom data with Nepali authorities. A rescue window is narrowing, and no Australians have been confirmed rescued.
